summary: FD_TC_176_Mixed Regime � EU Eligible but APPR Not Eligible (Different Controllability)
title: Mixed Regime � EU Eligible but APPR Not Eligible (Different Controllability)
description:
Mixed Regime � EU Eligible but APPR Not Eligible (Different Controllability). Flight from London LHR to Toronto YYZ. Disruption code maps differently under the two regimes � under EU 261 the cause is classified as controllable (eligible), but under APPR the same code maps to a different controllability classification resulting in Not Eligible. Per fixed priority, EU would be selected over APPR regardless, but this test validates that DDS applies each regime's OWN controllability rules independently and doesn't blend classifications. One regime can be Eligible while the other is Not Eligible for the SAME flight. EU is selected as the only eligible regime.

Prerequisites:
PNR: Single passenger (Bridget Carmichael), 1 leg AC operated LHR?YYZ. Itinerary: Scheduled arrival 16:00, Actual arrival 20:00 (4hr delay). Disruption code: A code that maps to controllable under EU 261 but uncontrollable under APPR (regime-specific classification divergence). Flight distance: LHR?YYZ = ~5,550km (>3500km). Flight status: Arrived (operated).
